clauses.clause: For each level, judge whether it looks stunning and list any boring, harmless or babysitting moments. Glitches remain objective defects to list separately.
clauses.note: Scope L1, L2, L3, L7, L8, L9, L10 (L4-L6 not reviewed). Harmless: L10 last 30 s of the console charge with 0 infected on screen; L9 6 % of observations with infected on screen and a 136 s empty approach drive; L7 no threat for 6 min while the group stood at the pharmacy corner. Boring: L10 Mega does not come to the arena; the objective sends the player 300 m back and then 335 m back again on an empty road. Not stunning: L10 research/military/corridor flat empty slabs, L3 zoom-1 smoke curtain, L8 dark monotone night. Glitches are listed separately in the README (P1: L2 fire engine cut in half on foot; L10 courier hidden at the console).

evidence.what: Per-level glitches / stunning / boring-harmless-babysitting judgments for L1, L2, L3, L7, L8, L9, L10 with ticks, positions and coverage limits.
L2: ride hull reveal (high z0.5), fire engine cut in half on foot (low z0.5), rescue-door camera at zoom 0.5 before/at/after the 57 m over-pull.
L3 zoom 1 high: smoke columns covering infected (health bars without bodies) and porthole cut-outs.
L10 R2 at max zoom (1.5 x region 1.3): near-side roofs filling the frame, faint infected under the dithered roof.
L10: courier hidden at the console charge, arena, Mega fight, death flash, empty walk back to release.
L1 station black void, L3 yard police, L7 group at the pharmacy fence, L8 black burning APC and mission-failed card, L9 arrow decals.

notes: Real-input playtest driver (WebGPU, god mode, per-step captures low/high x zoom 1.5/0.5) plus test-API sim-bot camera probes. Every listed capture was inspected; raw captures deleted, compact sheets retained.
